title: Laredo Police Department Announces Deadly Dozen Fitness Race for Feb. 13
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department is teaming up with Bodify Functional Fitness and Deadly Dozen USA for the Deadly Dozen, a hybrid fitness race on Saturday, Feb. 13 at the Buena Vista Sports Complex, with a First Responders Division open to law enforcement, military and first responders.
content:
The Laredo Police Department is bringing the community together for the Deadly Dozen, a hybrid fitness race set for Saturday, Feb. 13, at the Buena Vista Sports Complex.

The department announced the event Wednesday, Nov. 25, in collaboration with Bodify Functional Fitness and Deadly Dozen USA. The race is about more than fitness, the department said — it is about building connections, pushing limits, and bringing law enforcement and the community together through teamwork, strength and friendly competition.

A First Responders Division is open to active-duty and retired law enforcement, military members and first responders. The event is open to everyone, and participants can register by scanning the QR code in the department's announcement.

Sources: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 25, 2026.
